title: Reference the storyboard exactly. Maintain the same visual style, composition…
content:
Reference the storyboard exactly. Maintain the same visual style, composition, astronaut design, spacecraft design, Mars environment, lighting, and color palette throughout the entire video.

10-second cinematic sequence.

24fps.

ARRI Alexa 35 cinematic look.

IMAX-scale cinematography.

Anamorphic lenses.

Natural motion blur.

Photorealistic live-action.

Hollywood blockbuster quality.

Interstellar, Dune, The Martian visual style.

Physically accurate Mars environment.

Ultra-realistic dust simulation.

Premium cinematic color grading.

No CGI appearance.

No animation style.

No game-engine rendering.

No visual artifacts.

SECOND-BY-SECOND CINEMATIC FLOW

[0–2s] — FOR CENTURIES... IT WAS ONLY A DREAM

Massive orbital shot of Mars.

Golden sunlight emerges from behind the planet creating a bright rim glow.

Subtle atmospheric dust storms visible.

Camera slowly pushes toward the surface while stars drift naturally in the background.

Epic sense of scale.

Narration:
"For centuries... it was only a dream."
Music:
Deep atmospheric synths and distant choir.

[2–4s] — HUMANITY ARRIVES
Gigantic spacecraft descends through a red dust storm.

Powerful thrusters blast Martian dust in all directions.

Landing gear extends.

Ramp begins lowering.

Camera tracks low beside the spacecraft emphasizing scale and realism.

Dust interacts naturally with terrain.

Narration:
"Until humanity finally arrived."

Music:
Cellos and low brass begin building.

[4–6s] — THE FIRST STEP

Extreme close-up.
Astronaut boot descends toward untouched Martian soil.

Boot impacts surface.
Dust particles erupt and float through sunlight in ultra slow motion.

Camera follows the footprint as it forms.

Historical atmosphere.

Narration:
"And history changed forever."

Music:
Brief silence followed by a powerful orchestral hit.

[6–8s] — A NEW WORLD

Wide cinematic shot.

Astronaut stands alone overlooking the Martian landscape.

Tiny blue Earth visible in the distant sky.

Astronaut slowly turns toward Earth.
Wind moves fine dust across the surface.

Massive valleys and canyons stretch to the horizon.
Narration:
"A new world beneath our feet."

Music:
Choir and orchestra continue rising.

[8–10s] — THE FUTURE IS HUMAN

Epic hero shot.

Camera slowly pulls back revealing a futuristic Mars settlement.

Research domes.

Solar fields.

Exploration vehicles.

Golden sunlight floods the landscape.

Astronaut stands proudly overlooking the future of humanity.
Large cinematic title appears:

THE FUTURE IS HUMAN
MARS • 2035

Narration:
"This is only the beginning."

Music:
Full orchestral climax.

Fade to black.

Three piano notes.

Silence.

TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Photorealistic live-action.

NASA-level astronaut suit detail.

Realistic Mars geology.

Physically accurate lighting.

Natural camera shake.

Anamorphic lens flares.

Volumetric dust.
IMAX scale.

4K HDR quality.
Film-quality visual effects.

Consistent astronaut identity.

Premium cinematic storytelling.

No cartoon look.

No CGI look.

No low-quality rendering.

Award-winning Hollywood science-fiction commercial quality.

"Un nuevo mundo bajo nuestros pies."

Música:

[8–10s] — EL FUTURO ES HUMANO

La cámara se aleja lentamente revelando un asentamiento futurista en Marte.

Cúpulas de investigación.

El astronauta se encuentra orgulloso contemplando el futuro de la humanidad.

Aparece un gran título cinematográfico:

EL FUTURO ES HUMANO
MARTE • 2035

Narración:
"Esto es solo el comienzo."

Acción en vivo fotorrealista.

Detalle del traje de astronauta a nivel de la NASA.

Geología marciana realista.

Iluminación físicamente precisa.

Destellos de lente anamórficos.

Polvo volumétrico.

Escala IMAX.

Calidad 4K HDR.
